title: Differential Bias: On the Perceptibility of Stance Imbalance in Argumentation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the perceptibility of 'stance bias' (imbalance in argumentation) by human annotators. While the topics used in the experimental study include sensitive subjects like 'Atheism,' 'Abortion,' and the 'Death Penalty,' the paper's core objective is to model and measure the perception of argumentative balance, not to evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral truths, or ethical systems.
